name: Zhejiang Zhaolong Interconnect Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Zhaolong Interconnect Technology Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells data cables, special cables, and connection products. The company offers copper products, such as LAN cables, patch cords, modules, cable assembles, patch panels, and multi-pair products, as well as cabinets, and other accessories. It also offers MPO cables and accessories, optical cables, fiber patch cords, optical apparatus, and related products. In addition, the company provides industrial ethernet, fieldbus, sensor, low frequency data, marine, automotive, communication, rolling stock data, motion control, chain, servo, and robot cables.
